note: Prices are +20% over base, clean. Facts rewritten from operator's own tour data.

tours.title: Algeria Cultural Tour — 5 Days
tours.summary: Five days across the heart of Algeria — the UNESCO Casbah of Algiers, the Roman coast at Tipaza, and the timeless M'Zab Valley on the edge of the Sahara, with a private licensed guide throughout.
highlights: Walk the UNESCO-listed Casbah of Algiers
Roman Tipaza and the Royal Mausoleum of Mauretania
Cherchell Archaeological Museum and Mediterranean views
A Sahara afternoon around Ghardaïa
The historic M'Zab towns, including El Atteuf
Authentic Algerian food and everyday culture

itinerary.title: Arrival in Algiers
itinerary.body: Welcome at Houari Boumediene Airport and a private transfer to your hotel. Settle in and rest; overnight in Algiers.

itinerary.title: Tipaza & Cherchell
itinerary.body: After breakfast, drive the coast to the Royal Mausoleum of Mauretania and the Roman ruins of Tipaza. Lunch by the Mediterranean, then the Cherchell Archaeological Museum. Return for the night in Algiers.

itinerary.title: Algiers city & flight to Ghardaïa
itinerary.body: Explore the UNESCO Casbah, the Bardo Museum and the Martyrs' Memorial. In the evening, fly south to Ghardaïa for the night.

itinerary.title: Sahara around Ghardaïa
itinerary.body: A desert day near Ghardaïa with a traditional lunch and time in the dunes. Overnight in Ghardaïa.

itinerary.title: M'Zab Valley & return
itinerary.body: Visit El Atteuf and the Sidi Brahim mausoleum, lunch in Ghardaïa, then fly back to Algiers.

tours.title: Djanet Sahara Safari — 5-Day Tadrart Rouge
tours.summary: Five days deep in the Algerian Sahara around Djanet — the red sandstone of the Tadrart, golden dunes, prehistoric rock art, and nights under the stars with a local Tuareg team.
highlights: The sculpted landscapes of Tadrart Rouge
Ancient rock engravings and formations
Walks across golden dunes
Unforgettable Sahara sunsets
Nights in desert camps under the stars
Tuareg hospitality and tea rituals

itinerary.title: Arrival & into the desert
itinerary.body: Meet your desert team in Djanet, then a 4×4 drive into the Sahara. Sunset over the dunes and a first night at desert camp.

itinerary.title: Tadrart Rouge
itinerary.body: Drive through the Tadrart's red rock and sand valleys with photo stops, ending the day with sunset and a desert camp.

itinerary.title: Dunes & rock art
itinerary.body: Explore the great dunes and ancient engravings on foot, pause for tea, watch the sunset and overnight in camp.

itinerary.title: Deep desert
itinerary.body: Travel further into remote desert, into the silence and wide horizons of the Sahara; final night at camp.

itinerary.title: Return to Djanet
itinerary.body: Breakfast in the desert and a scenic drive back to Djanet, where the journey ends.

tours.title: Ghardaïa — 3-Day M'Zab Valley Tour
tours.summary: Three days in the M'Zab Valley — the fortified hill-towns of Ghardaïa and Beni Isguen, the ancient foggara water system, palm oases, and a 4×4 desert evening under the stars.
highlights: The mud-brick hill-town of Ghardaïa in the M'Zab Valley
The fortified village of Beni Isguen
The ancestral 'foggara' water-sharing system
Palm oases and traditional crafts
A 4×4 desert safari toward El Guerrara
Dinner under the desert stars

itinerary.title: Ghardaïa & the oasis
itinerary.body: Met at Ghardaïa airport and taken to your accommodation. Explore the hill-town's narrow alleys and lively market, lunch in a restored heritage house, then a palm oasis and the foggara channels. Dinner and overnight in Ghardaïa.

itinerary.title: Beni Isguen & desert safari
itinerary.body: Morning in the fortified village of Beni Isguen and the Tafilelt eco-town, with panoramic valley views. After a traditional lunch, a 4×4 safari toward El Guerrara and dinner in the open desert under the stars.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.body: A relaxed breakfast, then transfer back to the airport — the end of a journey through Algeria's Saharan heart.

tours.title: Western Algeria — Oran, Mostaganem & Tlemcen (5 Days)
tours.summary: Five days across the Algerian west — the lively port city of Oran, the beaches of Mostaganem, and the deep Andalusian heritage of Tlemcen, with its great mosque, palace and waterfalls.
highlights: Santa Cruz Fort and the panorama over Oran
Place du 1er Novembre and Oran's historic arena
The Mediterranean coast at Mostaganem
Tlemcen's Great Mosque and El Mechouar Palace
The Lalla Setti plateau and city views
Tlemcen National Park and the El Ourit waterfalls

itinerary.title: Oran
itinerary.body: Arrive in Oran and check in. Climb to Santa Cruz Fort for the view over the Mediterranean, then explore Place du 1er Novembre and the city's historic Roman-era arena.

itinerary.title: Oran
itinerary.body: Visit the Ahmed Zabana National Museum, the Sacré-Cœur, and walk Oran's seafront.

itinerary.title: Mostaganem
itinerary.body: Travel to Mostaganem for its beaches and the historic Bordj Ettork, with a relaxed Mediterranean afternoon.

itinerary.title: Tlemcen
itinerary.body: Discover Tlemcen's Andalusian heritage — the Great Mosque, El Mechouar Palace, and the Lalla Setti plateau.

itinerary.title: Tlemcen
itinerary.body: Visit Tlemcen National Park and the El Ourit waterfalls before departure.

tours.title: Algiers Day Tour — Hamma Garden, Notre-Dame d'Afrique & Army Museum
tours.summary: A relaxed private day in the capital taking in three of its landmarks — the botanical Jardin d'Essai du Hamma, the hilltop basilica of Notre-Dame d'Afrique above the bay, and the Army Museum — rounded off with a traditional Algerian lunch.
highlights: The historic Hamma botanical garden
Sea views from Notre-Dame d'Afrique
Algeria's military history at the Army Museum
A traditional Algerian lunch
Private guiding with hotel pickup

itinerary.title: Hamma Garden, Notre-Dame d'Afrique & Army Museum
itinerary.body: Pickup from your hotel or the airport, then a guided day across three sights: the botanical Hamma garden, the basilica of Notre-Dame d'Afrique on its hill above the Mediterranean, and the Army Museum, with a traditional lunch along the way before returning.

tours.title: Algiers Full-Day — Casbah, Bardo & Martyrs' Memorial
tours.summary: A full day through the heart of Algiers — the UNESCO-listed Casbah, the Bardo National Museum, and the Martyrs' Memorial with its sweeping view over the city and the sea, with a traditional lunch included.
highlights: The UNESCO Casbah, its alleys and old mosques
Archaeology and history at the Bardo Museum
The Martyrs' Memorial and its panorama
A traditional Algerian lunch
Views over Algiers and the Mediterranean

itinerary.title: Casbah, Bardo Museum & Martyrs' Memorial
itinerary.body: A guided full-day loop through the old Casbah quarter, the collections of the Bardo National Museum, and the Martyrs' Memorial, with a traditional lunch at a local restaurant between visits.

tours.title: Djanet & Ghardaïa — 6-Day Desert & Heritage
tours.summary: Six days pairing the great southern desert of Djanet with the M'Zab Valley — the red rock of the Tadrart, the rock art of Tassili n'Ajjer, desert camps under the stars, and the fortified villages of Ghardaïa.
highlights: Tadrart Rouge and its red rock formations
Prehistoric rock art at Tassili n'Ajjer (UNESCO)
Nights camping in the Sahara
Tuareg culture and a tea ceremony
The UNESCO M'Zab Valley villages
4x4 desert driving and dune sunsets

itinerary.title: Arrival in Djanet
itinerary.body: Met at Djanet airport and transferred to a guesthouse or desert camp, with a sunset excursion to nearby dunes and a traditional Saharan dinner.

itinerary.title: Tadrart Rouge
itinerary.body: A 4x4 day into the Tadrart, exploring rock formations and ancient engravings, a desert picnic, sunset over the red dunes, and a night camping under the stars.

itinerary.title: Tassili n'Ajjer
itinerary.body: Discover the Tassili plateau and its cave paintings, walking through canyons and sandstone landscapes, with dinner and a night in camp.

itinerary.title: Oases & desert culture
itinerary.body: Visit a local oasis and palm groves, meet a Tuareg community over a tea ceremony, and return to Djanet for the night.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Ghardaïa
itinerary.body: Travel to Ghardaïa in the M'Zab Valley, check in at a traditional guesthouse, and take an evening walk through the old town.

itinerary.title: M'Zab Valley & departure
itinerary.body: Visit Beni Isguen, El Atteuf and Melika, their mosques, souks and workshops, with lunch before the transfer to the airport.

tours.title: Eastern Algeria & Sahara Discovery — 6 Days
tours.summary: A six-day arc across Algeria's east — the bridges of Constantine, the Roman cities of Djémila and Timgad, a Saharan gateway at Bou Saada, and a Mediterranean day at Béjaïa.
highlights: The suspension bridges of Constantine
The Roman ruins of Djémila and Timgad (UNESCO)
Oasis and desert landscapes around Bou Saada
The Mediterranean coast at Béjaïa
Algiers, the historic capital

itinerary.title: Algiers to Constantine
itinerary.body: Arrive in Algiers and transfer to Constantine, with its suspension bridges, the Emir Abdelkader Mosque and the old town; overnight in Constantine.

itinerary.title: Constantine to Sétif
itinerary.body: Travel to Sétif and the UNESCO Roman ruins of Djémila, then explore the city center; overnight in Sétif.

itinerary.title: Sétif to Batna
itinerary.body: Continue to Batna and the UNESCO Roman city of Timgad, with time at local heritage sites; overnight in Batna.

itinerary.title: Batna to Biskra to Bou Saada
itinerary.body: Cross to Biskra, the gateway to the Sahara, for its palm groves and oasis scenery, then on to Bou Saada and its traditional markets; overnight in Bou Saada.

itinerary.title: Bou Saada to Algiers
itinerary.body: Visit Zaouia El Hamel and nearby heritage, then transfer to Algiers for a free evening; overnight in Algiers.

itinerary.title: Béjaïa & departure
itinerary.body: A day trip to Béjaïa for its fortress, Cap Carbon and coastal views, then the transfer to the airport.

tours.title: Complete Algeria — 10-Day Grand Tour
tours.summary: Ten days from coast to desert — the Roman sites of Tipaza, Djémila and Timgad, the Casbah of Algiers, Constantine's bridges, and the M'Zab Valley at Ghardaïa.
highlights: Roman cities: Tipaza, Djémila and Timgad
The UNESCO Casbah of Algiers
Constantine's suspension bridges
The M'Zab Valley at Ghardaïa
Traditional architecture and cuisine

itinerary.title: Arrival in Algiers
itinerary.body: Airport welcome, hotel check-in and a welcome dinner.

itinerary.title: Tipaza & Cherchell
itinerary.body: A coastal day at the Roman ruins of Tipaza — amphitheatre and mausoleum — with the Cherchell museum and sea views.

itinerary.title: Algiers historical tour
itinerary.body: The Casbah, the Martyrs' Memorial and the National Army Museum.

itinerary.title: Travel to Sétif
itinerary.body: Transfer east and visit the UNESCO Roman ruins of Djémila.

itinerary.title: Constantine
itinerary.body: City tour of Constantine — its suspension bridges, mosque and palace.

itinerary.title: Batna & Timgad
itinerary.body: Travel to Batna and explore the UNESCO Roman city of Timgad.

itinerary.title: Journey to Ghardaïa
itinerary.body: Travel south to the M'Zab Valley and check in at a guesthouse.

itinerary.title: Ghardaïa cultural tour
itinerary.body: The fortified villages, traditional mosques, souks and local cuisine of the M'Zab.

itinerary.title: Return to Algiers
itinerary.body: Travel back to the capital, with the Hamma botanical garden, the Bardo Museum and Notre-Dame d'Afrique.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.body: Breakfast and transfer to the airport.

includes: Entrance fees to the sites listed

tours.title: Timimoun Desert Escape — 5 Days
tours.summary: Five days in the red oasis country of Timimoun — its ksour and palm groves, the ancient foggara channels, great dunes, and a night of desert camp dining under the stars.
highlights: The red ksour and palm groves of the Gourara
The ancestral foggara irrigation system
A 4x4 safari across the great dunes
A 'Merdoum' dinner under the stars
Timimoun's traditional market
Cultural evenings with traditional music

itinerary.title: Arrival in Timimoun
itinerary.body: Welcome at Timimoun and transfer to the Ti Massin guesthouse, with time to settle in before a traditional dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Charouine — ksour & palm groves
itinerary.body: An excursion to Charouine for Ksar Guentour and its palm grove, an open-air lunch, and the ksar and oasis at Tala, returning for a dune sunset and a festive evening with music.

itinerary.title: Aghlad & Ouled Saïd — foggaras
itinerary.body: Visit the gardens and ancient foggara channels of Ouled Saïd, a palm-grove picnic with tea at Beni Aïssi and its ksar, and sunset over the large dunes.

itinerary.title: Desert adventure & star dinner
itinerary.body: The Ighzer site in the morning, then an afternoon 4x4 safari across golden dunes to a panoramic sunset, followed by a desert-camp 'Merdoum' dinner under the stars.

itinerary.title: Market & departure
itinerary.body: Visit Timimoun's traditional market for spices and handicrafts, then the return transfer toward Algiers.

includes: 4 nights at the Ti Massin guesthouse
Lunches and dinners as per program

tours.title: Béjaïa — Historic City by the Sea (Day Trip)
tours.summary: A coastal day at Béjaïa — its historic fortress and museum, the rugged Cap Carbon corniche, and time on the sand at Les Aiguades, with a traditional lunch by the Mediterranean.
highlights: The historic fortress of Béjaïa and its sea views
Museum exhibits on the region's history
The dramatic Cap Carbon coastline
Beach time at Les Aiguades
Authentic local Algerian cuisine

itinerary.title: Béjaïa fortress, Cap Carbon & the coast
itinerary.body: Pickup from Algiers, a guided visit of the historic fortress and its museum, a walk along the Cap Carbon corniche, beach time at Les Aiguades, and a traditional lunch before the return transfer.

tours.title: Tipaza & Cherchell — Private Roman Day Tour
tours.summary: A private full day on the Roman coast west of Algiers — the seaside ruins of Tipaza and the museum of ancient Caesarea at Cherchell, at your own pace with a personal guide.
highlights: The seaside Roman ruins of Tipaza (UNESCO)
Forum, baths and residential quarters
The Cherchell Archaeological Museum
A private, personalised pace
A walk through Cherchell's old harbour

itinerary.title: Tipaza ruins & Cherchell museum
itinerary.body: Hotel pickup and a private drive to Tipaza for a guided tour of its forum, baths and ancient quarters, then on to Cherchell — ancient Caesarea — for its museum of Roman statues and mosaics and a short walk in the old town, before the return transfer.

includes: Entrance fees to Tipaza and Cherchell

tours.title: Bou Saada — 2-Day Oasis Escape
tours.summary: Two days at Bou Saada, the 'City of Happiness' — its natural waterfall and the historic Ferrero Mill, lively craft markets, a Bedouin-style dinner with music, and the Sufi shrine of El Hamel.
highlights: Bou Saada, the 'City of Happiness'
The natural waterfall and the historic Ferrero Mill
Traditional craft markets
A Bedouin-style dinner with live music
The Sufi zawiya of El Hamel

itinerary.title: Algiers to Bou Saada
itinerary.body: Morning departure from Algiers by tourist vehicle, hotel check-in, then an afternoon at the natural waterfall, the historic Ferrero Mill and the traditional markets, with a Bedouin-style dinner and local music in the evening.

itinerary.title: El Hamel Zawiya & return
itinerary.body: After breakfast, visit the mountain Sufi shrine of El Hamel with time for photos and the landscape, a local lunch in Bou Saada, then the afternoon return to Algiers.

includes: Accommodation at the Kerdada Hotel or similar
Guided visit of the Ferrero Mill

tours.title: Algeria Intensive Discovery — 5 Days
tours.summary: Five fast-moving days across Algeria's headline sights — the Casbah of Algiers, Roman Tipaza and Cherchell, Constantine's bridges, the Roman cities of Timgad and Djémila, and a desert taste at Bou Saada.
highlights: The Casbah, Bardo Museum and Martyrs' Memorial
Roman Tipaza, Cherchell and Cleopatra Selene's mausoleum
Constantine's suspension bridges and palaces
The UNESCO Roman sites of Timgad and Djémila
A desert excursion at Bou Saada

itinerary.title: Algiers city tour
itinerary.body: Airport welcome and transfer, then the Bardo National Museum, a walk through the UNESCO Casbah, and the Martyrs' Memorial with its view over the capital.

itinerary.title: Tipaza & Cherchell
itinerary.body: West along the coast to the Roman ruins of Tipaza and the Royal Mausoleum of Mauretania, then Cherchell's museum and old harbour.

itinerary.title: Constantine & Timgad
itinerary.body: East to Constantine — its suspension bridges and Ahmed Bey Palace — and on to the Roman city of Timgad.

itinerary.title: Djémila & Sétif
itinerary.body: The UNESCO Roman city of Djémila with its forum, theatre and mosaics, then the Aïn El Fouara fountain at Sétif.

itinerary.title: Bou Saada & return
itinerary.body: South to Bou Saada, gateway to the Sahara, for its oasis and a desert excursion among the dunes, before the road back to Algiers.

tours.title: Algiers Culture Walk — Casbah Day Tour
tours.start: Algiers — lower Casbah, by the sea
tours.summary: A guided walk up through the UNESCO Casbah of Algiers — from the seafront and Martyrs' Square to Mustafa Pasha Palace, the citadel and the house of Ali La Pointe, ending at the seaside Rais Palace.
highlights: The narrow streets and old mosques of the Casbah
Mustafa Pasha Palace and Ottoman architecture
Panoramic terraces over the bay
The Casbah citadel and Ali La Pointe's house
The seaside Rais Palace (Bastion 23)

itinerary.title: Walking tour of the Casbah
itinerary.body: Meet your guide by the sea at the foot of the Casbah and climb through Martyrs' Square and its historic mosque, Mustafa Pasha Palace, a panoramic terrace, the citadel and the home of independence figure Ali La Pointe, ending at the seaside Rais Palace.

includes: Entrance fees to the included landmarks
Guided walking tour of the Casbah

tours.title: Constantine & Timgad — 2-Day Tour
tours.summary: Two days pairing Constantine, the dramatic city of bridges above the Rhumel gorge, with Timgad, one of the best-preserved Roman cities in North Africa.
highlights: Constantine's bridges and the Rhumel gorge
Ahmed Bey Palace and the Cirta Museum
Constantine's old city and markets
The Roman city of Timgad
Trajan's Arch, theatre and forum

itinerary.title: Constantine
itinerary.body: The Sidi M'Cid and Sidi Rached bridges over the Rhumel gorge, Ahmed Bey Palace, the Cirta National Museum, and the old city and traditional markets.

itinerary.title: Timgad
itinerary.body: The Roman city of Timgad — Trajan's Arch, the theatre, forum and public library, its grid plan, baths and temples.

tours.title: Roman Algeria — Tipaza, Djémila & Timgad (3 Days)
tours.summary: Three days through Algeria's finest Roman heritage — the seaside ruins of Tipaza and Cherchell, the hillside city of Djémila, and the grid-planned streets of Timgad.
highlights: The coastal Roman ruins of Tipaza
Caesarea (Cherchell) and its museum
Djémila's colonnaded streets and theatre
Mosaic floors and monumental gateways
Timgad's Roman grid and theatre

itinerary.title: Tipaza & Cherchell
itinerary.body: The Roman streets, bathhouses, temples and necropolis of Tipaza, then Caesarea (Cherchell) and its archaeological museum.

itinerary.title: Djémila (Cuicul)
itinerary.body: Djémila's colonnaded streets, monumental gateways, Roman theatre, religious complexes and mosaic-floored houses, with the local museum.

itinerary.title: Timgad
itinerary.body: The Roman theatre, forum and public library of Timgad, its famous grid plan, baths and temples.

tours.title: The Soul of Algeria — 4 Days
tours.summary: A four-day blend of capital culture, Roman coast and desert charm — the museums and Casbah of Algiers, the ruins of Tipaza and Cherchell, and the oasis town of Bou Saada, with accommodation included.
highlights: The Bardo Museum and Notre-Dame d'Afrique
The Martyrs' Memorial and the UNESCO Casbah
Roman Tipaza and the Cherchell museum
The oasis town of Bou Saada
A short journey across cultures and landscapes

itinerary.title: Algiers
itinerary.body: The Bardo Museum and its mosaics, Notre-Dame d'Afrique above the bay, and the Martyrs' Memorial.

itinerary.title: Tipaza & Cherchell
itinerary.body: The Royal Mausoleum of Mauretania, the Roman archaeological park of Tipaza, and the Cherchell museum.

itinerary.title: Bou Saada
itinerary.body: South to Bou Saada for its fortress and panoramas, the town museum of crafts and relics, and its historic mosque.

itinerary.title: Algiers
itinerary.body: Back to Algiers for the UNESCO Casbah, the Hamma botanical garden, and the Museum of the Mujahideen.

tours.title: Culture & Heritage of Algeria — 8 Days
tours.summary: Eight days across Algeria's culture and history — the capital and its Casbah, Roman Tipaza and Djémila, the bridges of Constantine, and the oasis town of Bou Saada.
highlights: Algiers, its museums and the historic Casbah
Roman Tipaza, Cherchell and Djémila
Constantine and its suspension bridge
The oasis charm of Bou Saada
A blend of culture, history and landscape

itinerary.title: Arrival in Algiers
itinerary.body: Airport welcome, check-in at a city-center hotel, an evening city tour and dinner.

itinerary.title: Algiers cultural tour
itinerary.body: The Bardo Museum, the UNESCO Casbah, and the Martyrs' Memorial (Makam Echahid).

itinerary.title: Tipaza & Cherchell
itinerary.body: The Royal Mausoleum of Mauretania, the Tipaza archaeological park, and the Cherchell museum.

itinerary.title: Constantine
itinerary.body: The Sidi M'Cid bridge, Ahmed Bey Palace, the Emir Abdelkader Mosque, and a city walk.

itinerary.title: Djémila
itinerary.body: The UNESCO Roman site of Djémila — its theatre and temples — with a local lunch.

itinerary.title: To Bou Saada
itinerary.body: The road from Constantine to Bou Saada, check-in and free time, and a traditional dinner with local music.

itinerary.title: Bou Saada & return
itinerary.body: The Bou Saada waterfall, the Ferrero Mill, and the El Hamel zawiya, then the return to Algiers.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.body: Breakfast, check-out and transfer to Algiers airport.

tours.title: Algeria Beyond Expectations — 10 Days
tours.summary: Ten days from the Mediterranean to the M'Zab — Algiers and Roman Tipaza, the Roman cities of Djémila and Timgad, Constantine's bridges, and the desert villages of Ghardaïa with a Saharan excursion.
highlights: Algiers and the Roman ruins of Tipaza
Constantine, the city of bridges
Sétif, Djémila and the Roman city of Timgad
The M'Zab Valley desert culture at Ghardaïa
A Saharan excursion with quad, camel and sandboarding

itinerary.title: Arrival in Algiers
itinerary.body: Airport reception, hotel check-in and a welcome dinner.

itinerary.title: Tipaza & Cherchell
itinerary.body: The Roman ruins and amphitheatre of Tipaza, the Royal Mausoleum of Mauretania, the Cherchell museum and coastal views.

itinerary.title: Algiers historical tour
itinerary.body: The UNESCO Casbah, the Martyrs' Memorial, and the National Army Museum.

itinerary.title: Travel to Sétif
itinerary.body: Transfer to Sétif and the Roman ruins of Djémila; overnight in Sétif.

itinerary.title: Constantine
itinerary.body: The suspension bridges of Constantine, the Emir Abdelkader Mosque and Ahmed Bey Palace; overnight in Constantine.

itinerary.title: Batna & Timgad
itinerary.body: Travel to Batna and the UNESCO Roman city of Timgad, with local heritage; overnight in Batna.

itinerary.title: Journey to Ghardaïa
itinerary.body: Travel south to the M'Zab Valley and check in at a traditional guesthouse, with a free evening.

itinerary.title: Ghardaïa cultural tour
itinerary.body: The villages of El Atteuf, Beni Isguen and Melika, their mosques and architecture, the souks and a lunch with a local family.

itinerary.title: Return to Algiers
itinerary.body: Travel back to Algiers, with the Hamma botanical garden, the Bardo Museum and Notre-Dame d'Afrique.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.body: Breakfast and transfer to the airport.

includes: Private local guide at major sites
All meals during the desert excursion
Desert activities: quad biking, camel riding, sandboarding
